name: sigma
title_zh: 每次只教一个点，直到你答对才往下走的私教
tagline_zh: 学不懂不是你的问题，是没人盯着你卡在哪。它用苏格拉底式追问+自适应节奏，每步配图配表。
tagline_en: Stuck isn't your fault—no one tracked where you lost it. Socratic probes, adaptive pacing, visuals at every step.
desc_en: Personalized 1-on-1 AI tutor using Bloom's 2-Sigma mastery learning. Guides users through any topic with Socratic questioning, adaptive pacing, and rich visual output (HTML dashboards, Excalidraw concept maps, generated images). Use when user wants to learn something, study a topic, understand a concept, requests tutoring, says 'teach me', 'I want to learn', 'explain X to me step by step', 'help m
why_zh: 机制核心是 Bloom 的 2-Sigma 效应：一对一 mastery learning。
why_en: Built on Bloom's 2-Sigma effect: mastery learning, one-on-one. It never hands you answers—it interrogates your misconceptions.
limit_zh: 只覆盖「概念理解」这一格：不批改作业、不教编程调试、不背单词。
limit_en: Only covers conceptual understanding: no homework grading, no coding debug, no vocab drills. Visuals need a browser. Requires typed dialogue—passive.
title_en: One-on-one tutor that won't advance until you get it
